description: This source file defines the UserRole entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping the 'ohrm_user_role' database table. It includes properties such as id, name, displayName, isAssignable, and isPredefined, along with their corresponding getters and setters, and default constructor initialization.

classes.name: UserRole
classes.description: Entity class representing a user role in the OrangeHRM system, including properties for id, name, displayName, assignability, and predefined status, and providing methods for property access and modification.
